scope: Cincinnati Music Hall on Elm Street after the 2016–2017 restoration, represented in February 2019. Includes Springer Auditorium, both brick exhibition wings and the towers and roof ranges.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The landmark nomination documents the central auditorium, flanking wings, rose window, porch and Gothic exterior details.
The restoration group documents the restored patterned red and black brick, carved sandstone and exterior finials.
The group documents the 2016–2017 renovation and the restored rose-window color and reopening of historic windows.
